subject: fix(app): make Loom models easy to add from the GUI (#4241)
summary: Makes Loom models easy to add from the GUI by searching by the Hugging Face repository name, detecting when a pulled model already exists in Lemonade's built-in catalog and handing it off to Load, and adding the checkpoint repository to the model list panel search index so pulled Loom bundles appear in results.
verdict_reason: The PR introduces user-visible GUI behavior — searching for and loading Loom models from the Hugging Face catalog — that has not been manually exercised before release.
